mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which is typically associated with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized increase of less than 1%, it indicates a potential monetary policy misstep, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the interaction condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the interaction condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a loosening monetary policy, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5pp.
